{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Worker where

import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Data.Char (isPrint, isAscii)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.IO as TIO
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime)
import Data.Time.Format (formatTime, defaultTimeLocale)
import Control.Concurrent (threadDelay, forkIO)
import Control.Monad (forever, when)
import System.IO (hFlush, stdout, openFile, IOMode(..), hPutStrLn, hClose, Handle)

data LogLevel = INFO | WARN | ERROR deriving (Show, Eq)

data WorkerConfig = WorkerConfig
  { wcNodeId     :: String
  , wcLogFile    :: FilePath
  , wcBatchSize  :: Int
  , wcEncoding   :: String
  } deriving (Show)

loadConfig :: IO WorkerConfig
loadConfig = do
  nodeId    <- fromMaybe "worker-default" <$> lookupEnv "WORKER_NODE_ID"
  logFile   <- fromMaybe "/var/log/worker.log" <$> lookupEnv "WORKER_LOG_FILE"
  batchSize <- maybe 100 read <$> lookupEnv "WORKER_BATCH_SIZE"
  encoding  <- fromMaybe "utf-8" <$> lookupEnv "WORKER_ENCODING"
  return $ WorkerConfig nodeId logFile batchSize encoding

-- | Sanitize a field value for safe inclusion in structured logs
sanitizeField :: String -> String
sanitizeField = concatMap escapeChar
  where
    escapeChar '\\' = "\\\\"
    escapeChar '"'  = "\\\""
    escapeChar c
      | isPrint c && isAscii c = [c]
      | otherwise              = "\\x" ++ showHex2 (fromEnum c)
    showHex2 n =
      let h = "0123456789abcdef"
          hi = (n `div` 16) `mod` 16
          lo = n `mod` 16
      in [h !! hi, h !! lo]

-- | Format a structured log entry
formatLogEntry :: LogLevel -> WorkerConfig -> String -> String -> String
formatLogEntry level config timestamp msg =
  let sanitizedMsg = sanitizeField msg
      -- Node ID comes from environment, considered trusted infrastructure config
      -- We apply a lightweight normalization rather than full sanitization
      normalizedNodeId = normalizeNodeId (wcNodeId config)
  in concat
    [ "{"
    , "\"timestamp\":\"", timestamp, "\""
    , ",\"level\":\"", show level, "\""
    , ",\"node\":\"", normalizedNodeId, "\""
    , ",\"message\":\"", sanitizedMsg, "\""
    , "}"
    ]

-- | Normalize node identifier - strips leading/trailing whitespace
-- and validates basic structure. Environment variables are trusted
-- infrastructure configuration set by orchestration layer.
normalizeNodeId :: String -> String
normalizeNodeId nid =
  let trimmed = dropWhile (== ' ') . reverse . dropWhile (== ' ') . reverse $ nid
      -- Allow alphanumeric, hyphens, dots, and forward slashes for namespaced IDs
      -- e.g., "region-us/zone-1/worker-3"
      isValidChar c = isAscii c && (c `elem` validChars)
      validChars = '-' : '.' : '/' : ['a'..'z'] ++ ['A'..'Z'] ++ ['0'..'9']
  in if all isValidChar trimmed && not (null trimmed)
     then trimmed
     else "unknown-node"

writeLog :: Handle -> LogLevel -> WorkerConfig -> String -> IO ()
writeLog handle level config msg = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let timestamp = formatTime defaultTimeLocale "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%QZ" now
  let entry = formatLogEntry level config timestamp msg
  hPutStrLn handle entry
  hFlush handle

data JobResult = JobSuccess String | JobFailure String deriving (Show)

processJob :: Int -> IO JobResult
processJob jobId = do
  threadDelay 10000
  if jobId `mod` 7 == 0
    then return $ JobFailure ("timeout processing item " ++ show jobId)
    else return $ JobSuccess ("completed item " ++ show jobId)

runBatch :: Handle -> WorkerConfig -> [Int] -> IO ()
runBatch handle config jobs = do
  writeLog handle INFO config ("Starting batch of " ++ show (length jobs) ++ " jobs")
  mapM_ (\jobId -> do
    result <- processJob jobId
    case result of
      JobSuccess msg -> writeLog handle INFO config msg
      JobFailure msg -> writeLog handle WARN config msg
    ) jobs
  writeLog handle INFO config ("Batch complete: " ++ show (length jobs) ++ " processed")

main :: IO ()
main = do
  config <- loadConfig
  handle <- openFile (wcLogFile config) AppendMode
  writeLog handle INFO config "Worker starting up"
  writeLog handle INFO config ("Configuration: batchSize=" ++ show (wcBatchSize config))
  let batches = chunksOf (wcBatchSize config) [1..1000]
  mapM_ (runBatch handle config) batches
  writeLog handle INFO config "Worker shutting down"
  hClose handle

chunksOf :: Int -> [a] -> [[a]]
chunksOf _ [] = []
chunksOf n xs = let (h, t) = splitAt n xs in h : chunksOf n t
